issue.title: just test-visual-update rewrites every PNG golden in the suite, silently absorbing unrelated drift
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-ky.2 (epic sase-ky, plan @plan:202608/plan_ref_kind_rename.md) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP on 2026-08-13T18:23:50Z; filed by sase-ky.land after search and the one-week task sweep found only node-specific snapshot-stabilization tasks (sase-l7/sase-l8/sase-l9/sase-la), not this update-mode defect.

WHAT HAPPENED: sase-ky.2's diff changed fixture text in tests/ace/tui/visual/_ace_prompt_png_snapshot_helpers.py and test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_clan_panel.py, legitimately affecting exactly 5 goldens (prompt_artifact_ref_highlight_120x40, prompt_glossary_highlight_dark/light_120x40, prompt_glossary_wrapped_highlight_dark_120x40, agents_clan_panel_epic_logical_prompt_hints_120x40). An earlier wholesale 'just test-visual --sase-update-visual-snapshots' sweep in that phase rewrote 211 goldens. The agent caught it, reverted the 211 to HEAD, and regenerated only the 5 -- but on inspection at least one of the wrongly-rewritten goldens (changespec_selected_row_120x40.png) had been captured with the footer keybinding-hint text missing entirely, i.e. update mode had blessed a genuinely wrong render as the new expectation. Nothing in the tooling flagged that 206 goldens moved for no reason in the diff.

ROOT CAUSE: tests/ace/tui/visual/png_diff.py:202-204 -- when the update option is set, every snapshot assertion unconditionally does write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes) and returns before any comparison. There is no scoping to the tests the author intended to update, no diff summary of which goldens changed, and no failure when a golden outside the intended set moves. Justfile:480 ('just test-visual-update' -> 'just test-visual -- --sase-update-visual-snapshots') applies the flag to the WHOLE 669-golden suite, so the documented one-command way to accept an intentional 5-golden change also silently re-blesses every unrelated golden, including any that is currently rendering wrong under host contention, font/renderer drift, or an in-flight bug.

WHY IT MATTERS: goldens are the only record of intended appearance. A wholesale re-bless destroys that record silently and is easy to miss in review because binary PNG diffs carry no visible content. sase-ky.2 only caught it by manually opening the rewritten files. CLAUDE.md documents test-visual-update as the way to accept intentional visual changes, so agents are actively steered into this.

SCOPE: make update mode account for what it changed and refuse to quietly widen. Options, not mutually exclusive: (a) in update mode, record every golden whose bytes actually changed and print/fail with that list at session end so the author must acknowledge each one; (b) make the flag require an explicit selection (node ids / -k expression / an explicit --all opt-in) and refuse a bare whole-suite update; (c) keep writing but report unrelated churn as a distinct non-zero exit so it cannot pass unnoticed; (d) add a guard test that fails when a commit touches goldens whose owning tests are not in the diff's import closure. Also update CLAUDE.md's PNG Snapshot Tests guidance to tell agents to scope regeneration to the affected test files and to sanity-check that unrelated goldens did not move.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-la — 'Stabilize test_preview_panel_reference_png_snapshot' describes the same mechanism from the other side ('the mismatch reproduces unchanged after restoring its unrelated update-mode golden rewrite'), i.e. another agent independently had an unrelated golden rewritten by update mode on 2026-08-13. sase-la is the node-specific stabilization; this bead is the tooling guard that would have prevented the rewrite.

RELATED: sase-l7, sase-l8, sase-l9 — three more node-specific PNG-snapshot stabilization tasks filed within the same few hours on 2026-08-13. Worth checking, when working this bead, whether any of their stale goldens were produced by a wholesale update-mode sweep rather than by real drift.

Triage sweep 2026-08-14 (requested by the project owner: keep the seven highest-impact open tasks, close the rest). These are per-node visual-snapshot stabilizations (artifacts/beads provider inventory, frontmatter panel, preview panel reference, the low-alpha xterm-256 palette audit) plus the just test-visual-update blast-radius defect. The PNG suite is excluded from 'just test' and 'just test-cov', so none of these blocks the shared check/check-full gates, and today's 'tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake' run names 12 reproducible flakes, none of them a PNG node. The update-mode hazard in sase-lo is real but mitigated by review discipline (goldens land in a diff). Re-file with a +1 if a golden mismatch blocks a landing.

payload.close_reason: Deprioritized in the 2026-08-14 task-backlog triage: PNG-golden drift is contained by the dedicated just test-visual lane and is not blocking the shared gates.
